q: What’s your daily routine like? What do you like doing in your free time?
answer: I usualy get up at about seven o'clock. Then I brush my teeth and prepare breakfast for my family. After work, I like reading and spending time with friends in my free time.
hint: Odgovori u sadašnjem prostom: ujutru, posle posla, vikendom. Poveži dve teme u 3–4 rečenice — rutina, pa slobodno vreme.

q: Do you like your job? Why? / Why not? What are your colleagues like?
answer: Yes, I really like my job because I love coding and working with tehnology. I always use technology at work and I don't have stress. My colleagues are respectful and friendly. I can rely on them and they help me.
hint: Prvo da/ne i kratak razlog, zatim opis kolega (ljubazni, pomažu, smešni). Koristi like / be + adjective.

q: Describe your home. Do you like living there and why? Would you like to move house and why?
answer: I live in Zemun in an apartment. Before, I lived in a house and I really prefer a house because I have more freedom and i don't share the building with neighbors. In my old house, I had a garden and space for sports.
hint: Opiši tip stana/kuće, sobe, kvart. Zatim zašto ti odgovara ili ne, i da li bi preselio — jedan jasan razlog.

q: What is your favourite place/town/city in your country? Talk about the things that are and aren’t in this place (hotels, restaurants, parks, etc.).
answer: My favorite place is Lake Palic. There is zoo in this town, and my children really love it. This town has a beautiful park and lovely lake. There is a restorant next to the zoo that we love. However, there aren't many hotels and it isn't very crowded.
hint: Imenuj mesto, reci šta IMA (there are / there is), šta NEMA (there isn’t / there aren’t) — kontrast je poenta zadatka.

q: Do you have any hobbies? Do you prefer indoor or outdoor activities? Why?
answer: I have several hobbies. I go to the gym three times a week. I prefer outdoor activities like hiking and scuba diving at the sea. These activities help me relax and I enjoy being in nature.
hint: Navedi 1–2 hobija, izaberi indoor ili outdoor i objasni jednom rečenicom (weather, relax, meet people).

q: How do you usually get to work? Do you travel by public transport a lot? If not, do you know anybody who does?
answer: I usually get to work by car. I rarely travel by public transport because I drive my wife to her job and my children in kindergarten. Yes I know someone - my father always goes to work by public transport because he doesn't spend money on gas.
hint: Kako stigneš na posao (by bus / on foot). Ako ne koristiš javni prevoz, spomeni nekoga ko koristi — treći lice u sadašnjem prostom.

q: What’s your favourite way of travelling and why? Describe your best ride ever.
answer: My favorite way of travelling is sailling in Greece because I really enjoy nature and the sea. My best trip was last summer - we sailed all day and anchored near a beautiful beach. In the afternoon we went fishing and prepared fish and salad. It was the best trip for me.
hint: Prvi deo: omiljeni način + razlog. Drugi deo: jedno konkretno putovanje (gde, sa kim, zašto je bilo sjajno).

q: How much time do you spend on the internet a day? Say the reasons why you go online.
answer: I spend about 16 hours on the internet every day. My jobs needs the internet, so I use it for work. I also go online to learn new things and read documentation for my job.
hint: Procena vremena (about an hour) + 2–3 razloga: posao, društvene mreže, vesti, učenje.

q: Where do you usually get your news? Is listening to the news important to you?
answer: I usually get my news from internet, blogs and podcast. Yes, it's really important for me because my job requires me to follow the news and stay up to date.
hint: Izvor (TV, app, radio, prijatelji) + važnost da/ne i jedna rečenica zašto.

q: What TV programmes do you prefer watching? Do you download them or watch them on TV? How often do you watch TV and what time of the day?
answer: I don't watch too much TV I prefer watching series on Netflix on my TV. I watch them about once or twice a week, usually in the evening. I never download them - I always stream them.
hint: Tip emisija + gde gledaš + učestalost (twice a week) + doba dana (in the evening).

q: How do you feel about shopping? What shops do you usually go to? What do you most like/hate buying?
answer: I like shopping. I prefer to go to the retail center Indjija because it has an outlet and the prices are really low. I most like buying shoes and shirts, but I hate buying jeans.
hint: Stav prema kupovini + konkretne prodavnice (supermarket, pijaca) + šta voliš / ne voliš da kupuješ.

q: Where were you last weekend? What did you do?
answer: Last weekend I was at Lake Palic with my family. We went to the zoo, and after that we went to restaurant for lunch then we walked to the lake and played football. In the afternoon I rode a pedal boat on the lake.
hint: Mesto + 2–3 aktivnosti u prošlom vremenu (went, visited, stayed, watched).

q: What things could you do when you were younger and you can’t do anymore?
answer: When I was younger, I could spend a lot of time on outdoor activities, but now I don't have much free time. I used to play outside every day, but today I spend my free time with my family instead.
hint: Koristi when I was younger / I could… but now I can’t. Dva primera su dovoljna.

q: When did you last go on holiday? Who did you go with and where? Why did you visit that place? What did you do?
answer: I last went on holiday in February. I went with my friends to Kopaonik. We chose that place because we like skiing. Every day we skied, and at noon we stayed at our favorite restorant for lunch. After lunch we skied again until the evening.
hint: Lanac: kada → sa kim → gde → zašto ta destinacija → šta ste radili (4–5 kratkih rečenica).

q: Where did you last go sightseeing? How did you travel? What did you see? Did you go on a guided tour or on your own/with friends? What did you like most about it?
answer: I last went sightseeing in Berlin. I traveled by plane with my friends. We visited the Reichstag and the Brandenburg Gate, and we saw the Berlin wall. We didn't use a guided tour - we explored on our own. I like the views from the Reichstag most.
hint: Odgovori na SVA podpitanja redom — kratko je u redu ako je jasno.

q: What’s the most important decision you made in your life/career?
answer: The most important decision in my life was when I got married to my wife. Because of that, I now have children with her. In my career, the most important decision was when I left my last job. I tought it was a good job, but when I started working for Raiffeisen Bank, I discovered a better opportunity.
hint: Jedna odluka + kada + zašto je bila važna + posledica (then I…).

q: What did you do last week? (On Monday morning, on Tuesday evening, last night, yesterday afternoon, the day before yesterday, etc.)
answer: Last week, on Monday morning I had a meeting with my team lead. On Thursday evening I went to a birthday party with my family. Last night I watched a movie at the cinema with my wife. Yesterday afternoon I went for a run in nearby wood. The day before yesterday I had a day off and spent all day in my garden cooking gulas.
hint: Pokaži vremenske izraze: uveži 3–4 tačke u prošlom (različiti vremenski markeri).

q: What are you and your family doing today?
answer: Today, I'm going fishing. My wife is working in the office and my children are going to kindergarten. This evening we're having dinner together.
hint: Sadašnji kontinuirani za plan za danas / šta rade sada: we’re having, my brother is working, I’m studying…

q: Imagine that you’re having an office party now. Describe how your colleagues look like. What are you doing at the moment? Who’s enjoying the party the most? Why?
answer: Right now, Tanja is wearing a beautiful hat and a perfect dress. Ana has a long hair and good shoes. Sofia is wearing very cute jewelry. Tanja is drinking something and Ana and Sofia are dancing. I'm enjoying the party the most because I've had a little drink and I'm playing the music.
hint: Zamisli sadašnjicu: izgled (is wearing, looks happy), šta radiš ti, ko je najodusevljeniji i zašto.

q: Talk about some things that you normally don’t do but you’re doing this week, or vice versa. Explain why.
answer: I usualy don't walk to work, but this week I'm walking every day because my car is at the garage. Normally I watchet Tv late, but this week I'm going to bed early - I have an important meeting.
hint: Kontrast usually + this week I’m… / or Normally I… but this week I’m not… Završi sa because…

q: Describe your perfect dinner with your family and/or friends as if it is happening now.
answer: We're sitting on the terrace near the sea. We're eating griled fish and talking about funny stories from history. The children are playing on the beach, and we're listening to the waves. Everyone is relaxed and happy.
hint: Pričaj u „sada“: we’re sitting, we’re eating, someone is telling a story — atmosfera.

q: Imagine that you’re late for a very important meeting and you can’t find a taxi. Describe what you’re doing and how you’re feeling at the moment.
answer: At the moment, I'm running from the traffic jam to the office. I'm calling my favorite colleague and I'm telling him to go to the meeting and take notes for me. I'm feeling very angry and afraid because I'm going to be late.
hint: Emocije (I’m feeling stressed) + radnje (I’m looking at my phone, I’m walking fast).

q: Imagine that you’re watching your favourite film right now. What’s happening in the film?
answer: I'm watching my favorite film now. It's a comedy film. The main character is young man and he is very funny. Right now, he is trying to find his lost dog in the city. He is running in the streets and talking to many people. Some people are helping him, but other people are laughing. In the end, he finds the dog in a small park and everyone is happy. I like this film because it is funny and interesting.
hint: Opiši scenu u sadašnjem kontinuiranom: the hero is running, they’re arguing…

q: Compare two people you know very well. Use “than” and as many adjectives as you can.
answer: I have two friends, Marko and Milos. Milos is younger than Marko. Milos has brown hair, but Marko has blond hair. Milos is quiter than Marko, and Marko is funnier than Milos.
hint: Minimum dve poređanja sa than: taller than, more patient than, busier than…

q: Talk about your family. Who’s the oldest, prettiest…. etc. person in your family?
answer: My grandmother is the oldest person in my family. My wife is the prettiest. My brother is the most handsome in our family.
hint: Superlativi: the oldest, the youngest, the most helpful — uz ime i kratku rečenicu.

q: Compare two places you know well.
answer: I know Belgrade and Novi Sad well. Belgrade is busier and more crowded than Novi Sad. Novi Sad is smaller but more relaxed than Belgrade.
hint: Dva mesta + than / more… than: gužva, cene, priroda, ljudi.

q: Who do you think has the best life of all the people you know? Why? Use as many superlatives as possible to describe that person’s life.
answer: I think my friend Ivana has the best life of all the people I know. She has the most interesting job, she travels a lot. She lives in the nicest flat I've seen, and she always looks the calmest and happiest in stressful situations.
hint: Izaberi jednu osobu i „naj…“: happiest, richest, most balanced — sa objašnjenjem.

q: What advice would you give someone who wants to get fit?
answer: You should go running three times a week. You should also walk or cycle to work instead of driving. You shouldn't eat sweets or sugary drinks. You shouldn't use the lift - take the stairs instead.
hint: Moraš eksplicitno should i shouldn’t (bar po jednom). 3–4 saveta.

q: What advice would you give someone who wants to learn English well?
answer: You should learn English once or twice a week. You should watch movies without subtitles. You should also read books in English. You shouldn't be afraid to make mistakes when you speak.
hint: should za dobre navike, shouldn’t za greške (samo gramatika, bez slušanja…).

q: What advice would you give someone who doesn’t want to lose a job?
answer: You should be reliable and finish your tasks on time. You should ask question if you don't understand something. You shouldn't ignore feedback.
hint: Poslovni saveti: reliable, on time, communicate — should / shouldn’t.

q: What advice would you give someone who can’t decide where to spend a peaceful and relaxing holiday?
answer: You should write a list of what you need - sea, mountains, silence. You shouldn't choose a very busy city if you want peace.
hint: Predloži korake: think about budget, quiet place, shouldn’t overplan…

q: What advice would you give someone who is going to become a parent soon?
answer: You should have enough energy for children. You should have understanding for your children, and you shouldn't spend too much money on toys.
hint: Empatija + praktično: sleep, help, shouldn’t expect perfection.

q: Are you going to look for a better job? Why? / Why not?
answer: No, I'm not going to change jobs right now because I am satisfied with my job.
hint: going to za plan. Kratak odgovor + razlog (money, learning, stability).

q: Would you like to move/travel abroad? What are you going to do there?
answer: I'd like to live in Spain for a ten years. I'm going to drink coctel to the beach.
hint: Would like to za želju, going to za konkretne planove na destinaciji.
